description: Several large language models have outperformed practicing clinicians in medical examinations across various specialities in multiple countries and languages.

Large language models have outperformed practicing clinicians in medical examinations across various specialties and languages.
Large language models (LLMs) can pass explicit social bias tests but still harbor implicit biases.
Large language models exhibit verbatim recall of copyrighted books from their pretraining data, even after finetuning on unrelated datasets.
